# llms.txt — Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering (BIPE)
# https://www.bipevns.org

> BIPE (Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering) is an AICTE-approved
> polytechnic in Phoolpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Founded in 2010
> by Purwanchal Educational Trust. JEECUP institute code: 4455.
> AICTE Permanent ID: 1-488233171. BTEUP-affiliated. AISHE-registered.
> Annual tuition: ₹30,150. Catchment: Eastern Uttar Pradesh + Bihar.

## Core Facts

- Full name: Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering
- Short name: BIPE
- JEECUP code: 4455
- AICTE Permanent ID: 1-488233171
- AICTE EoA 2026-27: F.No. Northern/1-46216893240/2026/EOA dated 16 March 2026
- BTEUP affiliation: active
- AISHE: registered with the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
- Founded: 2010 (Purwanchal Educational Trust)
- Campus: Village Gajokhar, Post Parsara, Phoolpur, Varanasi 221206, UP
- Campus size: 6 acres, single boundary
- Total sanctioned seats: 480
- Faculty: 40 (1:20 mentor ratio)
- Alumni placed: 1,000+
- Annual tuition (all branches): ₹30,150 (AFRC-approved)
- Hostel: boys' on-campus block
- Catchment districts: Varanasi, Mau, Ghazipur, Azamgarh, Chandauli, Mirzapur,
  Jaunpur, Sonbhadra, Ballia (Eastern UP) + Patna, Saran, Bhojpur, Buxar,
  Rohtas, Vaishali, Gaya (Bihar)

## Programmes (5 BTEUP-affiliated diploma branches)

- Computer Science & Engineering — BTEUP code 355, 60 seats
- Dairy Engineering — BTEUP code 327, 60 seats
  (rare: only ~4 institutes in UP offer this; alumni at Amul, Mother Dairy,
   Parag, Nestlé, NDDB)
- Civil Engineering — BTEUP code 322, 120 seats
- Electrical Engineering — BTEUP code 328, 120 seats
- Mechanical Engineering (Production) — BTEUP code 343, 120 seats

All programmes: 3 years · 6 semesters · eligibility Class 10 pass with
Mathematics and Science.

## Admissions

Admission exclusively via JEECUP (UPJEE Polytechnic) Group A counselling.
Apply at https://jeecup.admissions.nic.in — choose institute code 4455.

Bihar candidates: JEECUP fills BTEUP seats under an "all-India" category,
so Bihar students who appear for DCECE/BCECE are eligible to simultaneously
apply via JEECUP and choose BIPE 4455. BIPE is the closest BTEUP institute
to several Bihar border districts (Buxar, Bhojpur, Rohtas).
